budget_items.what_was_recorded: The total assessed value of real and personal property was reported as up 3.3% over the prior year.
budget_items.quote: the total assessed value of real and personal property in lunenburg was $2,437,942,740, representing a 3.3% increase over the fiscal year 2025 total of $2,360,796,780

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The levy limit build-up was presented, ending in a set FY2026 tax levy that was 3.5% above the prior year.
budget_items.quote: beginning with the prior year's levy limit of $31,602,108, the calculation added the statutory 2.5% increase of $790,053, new growth of $518,650, and debt exclusions of $2,213,678

budget_items.topic: Estimated FY2026 tax rate and average bill
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The estimated single tax rate and the average single-family tax bill were reported as increases over the prior year.
budget_items.quote: the estimated average single-family tax bill, based on the average assessed value of $517,296, would be $7,443.89, an increase of $192.99 over the prior year's average bill of $7,250.89.

budget_items.topic: Split tax rate impact at maximum CIP shift
budget_items.what_was_recorded: At maximum shift, the residential rate would fall and the commercial rate would rise; a $350,000 residential property would save $224.25 while a comparable commercial property would pay about $2,336.75 more.
budget_items.quote: at the maximum allowable cip shift of 1.50, the residential tax rate would decrease to $13.70 per thousand while the commercial tax rate would rise to $21.58 per thousand.

budget_items.topic: Split tax rate trade-off as stated by the assessor
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The assessor stated the residential savings at maximum shift would come at a cost to commercial taxpayers.
budget_items.quote: the $224 savings to residential taxpayers would come at a cost of approximately $2,300 to commercial taxpayers at maximum shift

budget_items.what_was_recorded: An accounts payable warrant was announced and circulated for signature.
budget_items.quote: chair nuzzolo announced an accounts payable warrant in the amount of $479,658.86, which was circulated for signature.
